lid_fasteners.support_shape: Square corner pad connected to two walls, with paired underside wedges
lid_fasteners.installation: Heat-set from the open rim with lid removed; installed screws approach upward from below in the desk orientation

tool_access_probe.installation: Lid and PCB clamps removed; install inserts before PCB/cartridges. BOOT cartridge must be removed for later left-front clamp screw access. Actual iron geometry must match the long narrow approach.

nut_trap_inventory.lid: Four circular blind heat-set pilots, preserved from006
nut_trap_inventory.pcb_clamps: Four circular blind heat-set pilots; lower hex/side entries removed in007
nut_trap_inventory.desk_bracket: Four blind heat-set pilots; bracket width reduced by 3 mm
nut_trap_inventory.actuators: Contact heat sets; guide/magnet pockets are functional capture features
nut_trap_inventory.unused_source_bracket: Legacy nut cuts and nut-slot helper removed; wrapper replaces this source bracket
nut_trap_inventory.remaining_nuts: Two exposed nylon contact jam nuts are hardware; no printed nut traps

corner_bosses.comparison: Same remaining body features and parameters; legacy columns replace the new corner pads in an unexported comparison only

cable_retention.status: Cable diameter supplied by user; concave-cradle and tie coupon fit pending
cable_retention.geometry: Block minus an open-top cylindrical groove; cable seated at groove bottom
cable_retention.legacy_parameter_note: cable_diameter_provisional remains an input key; default8 mm is measured. Groove clearance and tie/head values are provisional.
cable_retention.installation: With lid open, feed tie along X through the cradle tunnel, lay the insulated cable along+Y into the open concave groove, and close the tie with its head above the right shoulder. Tighten only enough to retain the jacket; leave internal slack before the electrical termination.
cable_retention.reference_geometry: Cable is seated on the true groove bottom. Loose rectangular tie route/head are fit/clearance envelopes, not printable parts or exact flexible bends. Bend radius, grip force and pull rating are unverified.

mounting_orientation.source_frame: Case coordinates: 49 mm PCB, 3 mm narrower shell, PCB top at Z10, concave cable cradle
mounting_orientation.world_frame: +Z toward desk; floor faces desk; lid and finger pads face downward
